newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.AFRICAN DECEMBER TRACTOR SALES UP 40 PCT YR/YR.
newsitem.headline: S.AFRICAN DECEMBER TRACTOR SALES UP 40 PCT YR/YR.

text.p: South African tractor sales of 6,049 units in 1996 were the highest since 1985 and 40 percent more than the previous year, the South African Agricultural Machinery Association said.
On a year-to-date basis sales were 40.4 percent up on last year at 6,049.
The association said sales of agricultural machinery stood at 1.6 billion rand last year -- the highest yet reported.
During 1996, agricultural machinery sales have been boosted by a bumper maize crop and pre-emptive buying ahead of expected price rises due to the fall in the rand.
The association said crop conditions in summer rainfall areas were still good and expected demand for agricultural machinery to remain high.
But it said two negative factors, pressure on prices due to the weak rand and uncertainty over prices for crops not yet harvested, could influence new sales.
